reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.content:
I absolutely love my 2021 Toyota Camry. From the moment I got it, I honestly fell in love with it. The car looks sporty and modern, but at the same time it’s very comfortable and smooth to drive. It feels reliable and safe, which gives me a lot of confidence, especially as someone still getting used to driving more often.

The fuel efficiency is great, and the interior is clean and well-designed. Everything feels solid and easy to use. It’s definitely a great value for the price. If I had to mention something, I wish it had push-button start, but overall I’m extremely happy with my purchase.

I would definitely recommend this car to anyone looking for something reliable, stylish, and comfortable.
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Nasir M
reviews.content: Great value. Car runs great and really smooth. No problems
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Mary A
reviews.content:
I absolutely love the features of my car. The push start, sunroof, heated seats, heated steering wheel, and Apple CarPlay are all fantastic. For the value, the car is a great choice. Being a Toyota, its built to last and is also very fuel-efficient. Both the exterior and interior are incredibly clean, which adds to its appeal.

That said, there are a couple of things I wish were different. I’d love if the car had memory seats, and the display screen could be a bit more modern, especially compared to the ones in the Toyota Highlanders. Another small inconvenience is that, unlike the Highlanders where Apple CarPlay connects wirelessly through Bluetooth, my car requires the phone to be plugged in for CarPlay to work. While this isnt a huge issue, it would be more convenient if it were wireless like in the Highlanders.

Overall, it’s a really cute car and an amazing choice for a first car. Im really happy with it!
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Amy W
reviews.content: This car runs good, doesn't burn oil and is excellent on fuel. This car is a 4 cylinder and I have kept it up throughout the last three years I've owned it. I replaced some things such as struts, starter, fixed exhaust that leaked and cylinders. Oil change every month and today as a matter of fact, I just had it done. The tires are one year old and the auto shop said that there is a slight leak within the radiator, but that's about it.
reviews.title: Review

reviews.author: Moises M
reviews.content: Good value for a new car considering used prices are a bit crazy right now. Ride is smooth , absorbs bumps and harsh roads are not a problem for this car. I average  about 60 miles to and from work everyday and so far I average  52 mpg, most of it is highway miles too.  10/10 would recommend it to anyone.
reviews.title: Review

post.description: Finding used vehicles for sale near a US ZIP code, comparing prices against CarGurus' market value, or enumerating trims and counts for a model in an area. Chain listing_id into get_listing, entity_id into model_owner_reviews, and use suggest_vehicles or list_makes/list_models to obtain entity ids first.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

body_type_group_ids.description: Body style group ids: 0 Coupe, 1 Convertible, 3 Hatchback, 4 Minivan, 5 Pickup Truck, 6 Sedan, 7 SUV / Crossover, 8 Van, 9 Wagon (the numeric part of a listing's body_type_group_id bg<n>).

distance_miles.description:
Search radius in miles; the site offers 10, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 500 and 50000 (nationwide). Default 50. Only listings physically within the radius are returned (the site's nationwide store-transfer / home-delivery padding is switched off).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50000.

end_year.description:
Latest model year.

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

entity_id.description: CarGurus ontology id to search: a make (m7 = Toyota), model (d292 = Toyota Camry), model year (c33246) or trim (t56819), from suggest_vehicles, list_makes or list_models. Omit to search all vehicles. Pattern: ^[mdct][0-9]{1,9}$.

make_model_trim_paths.description: Make/model/trim paths as the site encodes them, e.g. ["m7", "m7/d292"] or ["m7/d292/XLE AWD"] (a trims facet value). Usually unnecessary: the site derives them from entity_id.

Maximum odometer miles.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

max_price.description:
Maximum listing price in USD.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

max_results.description:
Return only the first N listings of the page (the site's page is 24 tiles; next_page still advances by site page). Default: the whole page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 24.

min_mileage.description:
Minimum odometer miles.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

min_price.description:
Minimum listing price in USD.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

page.description:
1-based page number (page 1 carries 18 organic results, later pages 21, plus sponsored tiles); use next_page from the previous result. A page past the last one is invalid_input.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000.

sort_dir.description:
Sort direction. Default ASC.

Provider reference: allowed values ["ASC", "DESC"].

sort_type.description:
Sort key: BEST_MATCH (default), DEAL_SCORE (best deals first), PRICE, MILEAGE, PROXIMITY, NEWEST_CAR_YEAR, AGE_IN_DAYS (listing age).

Provider reference: allowed values ["BEST_MATCH", "DEAL_SCORE", "PRICE", "MILEAGE", "PROXIMITY", "NEWEST_CAR_YEAR", "AGE_IN_DAYS"].

start_year.description:
Earliest model year.

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code the search radius is centred on. A ZIP the site cannot resolve is invalid_input. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

200.description:
Search CarGurus used-car listings within distance_miles of a US ZIP code. Narrow by ontology entity (make m<n>, model d<n>, trim t<n>) or make_model_trim_paths, price, model year, mileage, body style, transmission and sort order. Returns one page of up to 24 listings (18 on page 1) (id, VIN, title, year/make/model/trim, price in USD with CarGurus' expected price and deal rating, mileage, days on market, distance, colors, powertrain, photo, dealer summary), the total match count, the resolved search location, selected facets with counts (body style, condition, deal rating, transmission, fuel, drivetrain, seller type, color, trims) and the next page number. Sponsored tiles (priority, featured, highlight) are listings marked sponsored=true; a sponsored tile that repeats an organic row on the same page is dropped, as are merchandising cards. Only listings within distance_miles are returned (no nationwide delivery or store-transfer padding).

The response contains the tool result directly.
